dispositions.CONFLICTING: For non-endpoint questions, retain incompatible assertions/proposals with their kinds and unequal authority. For the endpoint label apply endpoint_rule component scope; retain every episode conflict separately regardless of that label.
dispositions.NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS: The casebook supplies no substantive evidence for this domain. Scope absence to this case, and cite explicit omission statements when available; do not infer global absence.
dispositions.SUPPORTED: The stated narrow toy proposition is supported. State its exact scope and separately list missing parts of the full question. This never certifies question completeness, branch eligibility or admission.
dispositions.UNRESOLVED: A requested material join, meaning or choice lacks toy support. Preserve supported subclaims and state the gap; hypothetical alternatives alone do not establish a conflict between authenticated sources or readers.

endpoint_rule.applies_to: endpoint question only; all original seven question texts remain authoritative within the form
endpoint_rule.assessment_evidence: Individual assessment, source criteria/system/version, evaluability, assessment date/day and window; preserve documented missingness and gaps without timing defaults.
endpoint_rule.episode_rule: Episode matching is reported in episode_link_disposition and episode_bindings, with explicit same-patient/same-episode source locators retained. An episode-only conflict does not replace the meaning/assessment summary label. Scope this status to the proposed specimen/outcome use; do not globally invalidate distinct native episodes.
endpoint_rule.field_placement: For the endpoint assertion add endpoint_components with exactly the listed fields. Other grouped assertions keep the v2 fields.
endpoint_rule.provenance_rule: Retain all raw values, unsupported proposals, alternatives, source locators, gaps and conflicts. Existing frozen source-priority and no-conversion rules remain unchanged.
summary_rule_order: If meaning or assessment is CONFLICTING, endpoint disposition=CONFLICTING. The conflict must concern supported endpoint assertions under the existing source-priority rule, not an unsupported proposal acquiring authority.
Otherwise if meaning and assessment are both SUPPORTED, endpoint disposition=SUPPORTED for those components only.
Otherwise if neither domain is addressed (both NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS), endpoint disposition=NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS.
Otherwise endpoint disposition=UNRESOLVED; a missing required component cannot pass.
endpoint_rule.use_rule: The full endpoint question still requires the same-episode individual assessment. SUPPORTED summary is not full-question completion. Any missing/conflicting meaning, assessment or episode match withholds use; actual_use_authorized remains false for every synthetic example and creates no real approval.

instructions: Fill all seven question IDs for every case. Use only supplied toy lines, never prior reader answers or real Prat facts.

Separate supported facts, unsupported legacy proposals, hypothetical alternatives, gaps and scoped absence into subclaims using the listed kinds. Each subclaim preserves its provenance; a proposal is never a CASE_FACT.

support_scope states exactly which proposition is supported or unresolved. remaining_gaps lists unestablished parts of the full question even if a limited proposition is SUPPORTED. A named specimen/assay link does not prove exact header/object linkage or branch eligibility.
For a conflict, retain every incompatible assertion with its kind, locator and unequal support. Never grant an unsupported proposal authority or transfer an outcome across episodes.
Hypothetical X/Y alternatives in a case are not the exercise readers' answers. If no toy rule selects between them, retain the unresolved choice. Equal legacy bytes cannot select an interpretation.

Every line reference must exist in the same toy object. NOT_IN_INSPECTED_OBJECTS may cite explicit omission text; cite it when supplied. Empty line lists are allowed only when the domain is simply not addressed and there is no explicit omission locator. Explain the case-limited scope.
Do not infer alias merges, episode joins, endpoint conversions, measurement scale, roles, eligibility or permissions. Every statement is invented training content.
real_source_data_used=false. actual_source_approval=PENDING_NOT_ESTABLISHED and actual_reader_authentication=NOT_RUN. This rehearsal neither appoints readers nor grants access.
peer_material_seen must be truthful. It is a process self-report, not authenticated independence. Do not read any earlier or current peer pass.
usability_notes records any remaining ambiguity; do not invent either agreement or disagreement. These form fields are training annotations, not frozen schema extensions.

For endpoint only, place the required endpoint_components object beside the existing assertion fields. Follow endpoint_rule for disposition. This local training summary is not a new clinical endpoint or a production eligibility predicate.
Do not delete an episode conflict to obtain an endpoint summary. Cross-reference the episode_bindings assertion, preserve the conflicting proposal/subclaim and keep actual_use_authorized=false.
Meaning and assessment summaries cannot stand in for complete endpoint or branch eligibility; missing same-episode evidence remains blocking even when both summary components are supported.

Assessment support requires the source assessment system/version, evaluability, date/day and window, or explicit gaps, under the frozen ontology. Select no new timing default. episode_link_disposition refers to the proposed case-specific use, not a global invalidation of other native episodes.

questions.question: Which lexical aliases refer to each originating person and what supports each canonical link?
How does each person relate to distinct specimens, assays and exact headers/objects?
Which index episode and components support each selected exposure, specimen and outcome?
What source-supported pre-index/archival/repeat/lesion/assay policy was fixed before outcome-based selection?
What exactly does the native endpoint mean and which same-episode individual assessment supports it?
What exact measurement and processing contract supports this object and proposed branch use?
What originating-family overlap and actual prior use affect protection for this review?
